title: POST /v1/assets/{asset}/retire request body
description: Retire a unit that is not installed (work.evidence): out of the inventory for good, with its reason (REPLACED, FAILED, DISPOSED, RETURNED_TO_VENDOR, LOST). Final: a retired unit is never installed again and its code is never reused; its history stays readable. A like-for-like replacement retires the unit it takes out unless the body says outgoing SPARE.
